with_social.description: Modo completo CON estado social — instrucciones estructuradas por jerarquía. Usa {ctx}/{n_people}/{motion_hint}/{mapping}/{keys}/{slots}.
with_social.template:
Context: {ctx} ({n_people} people with purple ID<number> boxes).
{motion_hint}Mapping (Box Label -> Key):
{mapping}

Generate JSON for keys [{keys}] using schema {{{slots}}}:
1. 'action': describe the REAL, SPECIFIC thing each person is doing or attending to — whatever you actually observe, not a fixed category. This includes gaze/attention (e.g. 'watching camera', 'observing', 'looking around'), gestures, and activities (eating, reading, using phone, etc.), not just posture. Do NOT default to a bare 'standing'/'sitting' when something more specific is visible.
   - IF moving/walking -> 'walking' ONLY (do not combine with posture).
   - IF the lower body/legs are NOT visible (e.g. close-up, only upper body/face in frame), do NOT guess 'standing' or 'sitting' at all — describe only the observable behavior, no posture prefix.
   - IF sitting -> base posture is 'sitting' (MUST see bent legs/seat).
   - IF talking -> include 'talking' (MUST see mouth moving in conversation, not chewing).
   - Otherwise (legs visible), combine posture ('standing'/'sitting') with whatever specific behavior is visible using 'and' (e.g., 'standing and watching camera', 'sitting and eating', 'standing and using phone', 'sitting and reading').
2. 'social': EXACTLY one of [ATTENTIVE, AVAILABLE, BUSY, ENGAGED, MOVING].
   - ATTENTIVE: Eyes/face clearly turned TOWARD the camera. If looking away, to the side, or at something/someone else, do NOT use ATTENTIVE (use AVAILABLE instead).
   - AVAILABLE: Idle, not looking at camera/others.
   - BUSY: Phone/reading/eating/drinking/solo task.
   - ENGAGED: Face-to-face talk with another.
   - MOVING: Actually walking/changing position across the clip. A person standing or sitting still (even if talking, gesturing, or briefly occluded) is NOT MOVING — never infer this from a single frame or from box/box-color jitter alone.
   - Make sure 'social' is consistent with 'action' — if 'action' describes a real conversation/interaction, use ENGAGED even if there's slight movement; only use MOVING if there's no real interaction happening.

Constraint: Do NOT put social states inside 'action'. Output ONLY raw JSON.

motion_hint.description: Nota anti-sesgo para clips de video (solo modo full): no juzgar 'walking' desde un solo frame estático.
motion_hint.template: Note: Track gait across clip. Do not label walking as standing from a single static frame.
